summary: 10 seconds after casting, the caster may remove any States or Ongoing Effects they choose from themselves; castable even while Stunned or Suppressed.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: Any number of States or Ongoing Effects of the caster's choice, removed 10 seconds after casting.

requirements.note: May be cast at any time the caster is alive, even while Stunned, Suppressed or similarly prevented from casting.

properties.note: May be cast at any time the caster is alive, even while Stunned, Suppressed or similarly prevented from casting.
Caster chooses which States or Ongoing Effects (any number) to remove.

references.name: stunned
references.note: Does not prevent casting Shake It Off.

references.name: suppressed
references.note: Does not prevent casting Shake It Off.

clarifications.text: Shake It Off can be cast whenever the caster is alive, even while Stunned, Suppressed or otherwise prevented from casting.
Immunity to Shake It Off matters only when it is cast, not when the removal happens 10 seconds later.

open_questions: 'Any number of States' literally includes Cursed, but Shake It Off is Spirit and a Cursed caster is Immune to Spirit when casting (N1: immunity matters at cast time); bypass-cursed was not recorded.
